services.desc: Music is better together! Explore the world of music on a self-guided group tour or a group tour led by an experienced museum guide. Explore the world of music on a self-guided group tour or a tour led by an experienced museum guide. Complete your day by adding lunch, a musical activity, or a VIP experience. The Great Guitars tour showcases a selection of notable guitars throughout the galleries. See guitars owned and played by important musicians, guitars with innovative designs and interesting forms, and guitars that illustrate the instrument’s development and variety.
